title: Synthesize the continuity research and deliver the first redesign slice
body:
Outcome: lead session continuity (context budget, handoffs, memory, restart) works without loss, per the operator: "zrob doogłębny research potem jak z tym pracować, jak to przełomowo ugryźć, jak to ogarnąć lepiej, każdy aspekt musimy rozwiązać i potencjalne audytować" and the standing outcome in .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/handoff.md.
Inputs: three independent Opus lenses .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/{external,audit,redesign}.md (brief.md beside them); remember-research.md; context-audit.
Proof: a synthesis file with ranked changes, each with a metric computed from transcripts or records before and after; the first slice merged with its metric measured; follow-ups recorded as tasks; contradictions with ADR 0014/0002 raised to the operator first.
